newsitem.title: UK: LME copper firms again late in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper firms again late in evening session.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) three month copper prices added to their afternoon gains late on Wednesday's evening session.

The three months contract stretched from a kerb close of $2,379/$2,380 to $2,386/$2,390 in the few minutes of trading coming up to 1800 GMT and the Comex close. The rest of the time since the kerb had been spent quietly.
Morning losses were wiped out before the kerb began and a bounce from the early $2,325 low demonstrated the market's volatility, traders said.
Tightening spreads and real or pending strikes at two major copper mines stoked the rally, traders said.
Aluminium added three dollars to its kerb close to $1,648/$1,650 but there was little movement among the other metals.
